description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary nursing leader to make a significant impact on patient care and staff development within a supportive environment. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in upholding the highest standards of clinical excellence and operational efficiency.

This role offers a competitive annual salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000, commensurate with experience. We are looking to fill this critical leadership position urgently and invite qualified candidates to apply promptly. Join a team committed to providing compassionate and high-quality care to our residents.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role (e.g., ADON, DON)
Prior experience working within a Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations and compliance
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000, commensurate with experience.

roleTitle: Registered Nurse Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Registered Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center as an Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON). This pivotal leadership role involves overseeing clinical operations, ensuring exceptional patient care, and supporting our nursing team. If you are passionate about making a difference in the lives of residents and thrive in a dynamic environment, we encourage you to apply.

This is an urgent opening for a highly motivated individual ready to contribute to a compassionate and professional healthcare setting. We offer a competitive salary and the opportunity to advance your career within a supportive team.
requirements: Valid Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Kansas
Previous experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care facility
Prior leadership or supervisory experience in a healthcare setting
Strong clinical assessment, organizational, and communication skills

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Missouri Valley, IA, as an MDS Coordinator. This vital full-time role involves ensuring accurate and timely completion of the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, which are crucial for resident care planning and regulatory compliance. You will play a key part in optimizing resident outcomes and maintaining high standards of care.

This is a stable, full-time opportunity offering a competitive annual salary range of $65,000 - $75,000. We are looking for a committed professional to join our team permanently, not an interim position. If you are an experienced RN with a passion for comprehensive patient assessment and regulatory excellence, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Experience with the Minimum Data Set (MDS) 3.0
Strong clinical assessment and documentation skills
Experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $65,000 - $75,000, based on experience.
